foot_slip_definition.numerator: number of contacting-foot samples whose world-horizontal foot-speed proxy is strictly greater than threshold_mps
foot_slip_definition.denominator: number of contacting-foot samples, summed over all four feet and control steps
foot_slip_definition.contact_semantics: contacting foot is a registered foot sensor sample whose force magnitude exceeds contact_force_threshold_n

qualification_note: Metrics schema is registered; complete episode collection has not passed runtime qualification.

measurement_notes.foot_slip_contact_fraction_and_tangentia: legacy v0.2 schema identifier retained for compatibility; the collected speed is the world-horizontal proxy defined above, not terrain-tangent speed
measurement_notes.foot_slip_contact_fraction: world-horizontal foot-speed proxy; it is not a direct measurement of foot-to-ground tangential velocity
measurement_notes.swing_foot_clearance_m: non-contact foot height above the generated surface minus that foot's median contacting sole offset
